projects.name: Card and Dispute Management (UKCD) - Barclays ( Nov 24 - Dec 25)
details: Responsibilities
Led business analysis and solution design initiatives across UK Cards and Dispute Management, defining target-state processes and operating
models.
Defined end-to-end business process and integration requirements for card issuance, authorization, settlement, chargebacks, and dispute
management.
Defined the Target Operating Model (TOM) for UK Cards and Dispute Management by assessing existing operating processes, identifying
process gaps and defining the desired future-state operating model across business, operations and technology teams.
Identified opportunities to standardize Cards and Dispute Management processes, roles and operational hand-offs across the target operating
model to improve consistency, control and operational efficiency
Mapped AS-IS to TO-BE operating processes across card issuance, authorization, settlement, chargebacks and dispute management,
identifying opportunities for process standardization, improved controls and operational efficiency.
Worked with business, operations and technology stakeholders to define future-state roles, process flows, system interactions and customer
servicing journeys, ensuring alignment between the target operating model and the transformed Cards operating environment.
Shaped API-led architecture and customer servicing journeys through collaboration with business, technology, and operations stakeholders.
Facilitated stakeholder workshops, drove process optimization, and improved dispute resolution efficiency and operational controls.
Supported Agile delivery, UAT governance, defect triage, and implementation of readiness to ensure successful business outcomes.
